verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own ledger primitives. Funds are split between each user's balance account and the platform's liable balance account, costs can be deducted, and Adyen-generated reports support bookkeeping and reconciliation. However, end-to-end traceability of each movement from charge through split to payout, and penny-level reconciliation, are claimed only at a high level. Missing for 10: documented per-seller and platform fee-account balance views or reporting, transaction-level lineage linking charge to split to payout, detail on report granularity for exact reconciliation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform's money is legible — balances by seller and by my own fee accounts, every movement traceable from charge through split to payout, reconcilable to the penny

citations.quote: you have to include instructions on how to split the funds between your user's balance accounts and your marketplace's liable balance account.
